# Break-even calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/break-even/

Calculate the unit sales needed to cover fixed costs using a selling price and a variable cost per unit. See the rounded-up break-even quantity.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Estimate how many products must sell when fixed costs are 10000 and each sale contributes 250.

## Limits and checks

The model assumes constant unit prices and costs. Selling price must exceed variable unit cost to reach break-even.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
